name: deletion
operation: deleteListing (direct DELETE on provider_profiles) and deleteAccount (Edge Function delete-account)
notes: Both are HARD deletes. Dart ProviderRepository.deleteListing is documented as 'soft-deletes' (provider_repository.dart:217) and ListingStatus.deleted exists in Dart, but SQL has no deleted status and cascades the row away (docs/backend-contract.md 4.6).

deleteAccount removes auth.users and cascades all public rows (consent, reports, engagement), but backend/supabase/functions/delete-account/index.ts does not delete Storage objects in provider-photos or credential-evidence, so files can outlive the account.
A DELETE on a row the caller does not own returns 204 with zero rows (RLS filters it), indistinguishable from success unless 'Prefer: return=representation' is sent and the result is counted.

error.description: Non-owner delete. Today: HTTP 200 with an empty array under return=representation (or 204 without it). Target: a delete_my_listing RPC raising not_owner.

error.message: You cannot delete another provider's listing.

error.description: Missing or invalid JWT (index.ts lines 33-45). The function's own body uses bare snake_case 'not_authenticated', not the envelope; normalized form maps it to AUTH_REQUIRED.

error.message: Sign in again to delete your account.
